example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই অপমানজনক কথা তার গলায় লেগে গেছে, বলতে পারছে না।
খাবারটা গলায় লেগে গিয়েছে, গিলতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: That insulting remark sticks in his throat; he can't bring himself to say it.
The food is stuck in his throat, making it hard to swallow.
note: This idiom often conveys emotional reluctance to speak rather than literal physical obstruction.
